note: Wording of three items transcribed verbatim from Table 1 of the main article ('COVID-19 Vaccine Misinformation Beliefs' rows 1-5; '1.'..'5.' numbering and '(Item N)' labels stripped); the S1 Appendix (pone.0276082.s001) does not list this block. Codes: data/enders_2022_conspiracy_vaccine.py keeps the Qualtrics column names COVVAXINFO_1..5; Raw Data.csv (OSF 6a7et) has no question-text row and no codebook, and Analyses.do (lines 166-174, 512-514) refers to them only as covvaxinfo_1..5 (no mnemonic names, unlike the COVCONS block), so nothing in the study's files ties a code to a statement. Table 1 is sorted by % agreeing and its (Item N) labels are rank positions, not codes (live COVVAXINFO_1 is 11.198% agree, not Item 1's 18%). Mapping from live % resp>=4 (do-file dich cut) vs Table 1's 18/15/12/11/11: live COVVAXINFO_1..5 = 11.198/17.828/11.392/15.002/12.567. Over all 120 assignments the minimum summed deviation (1.332) is attained only by give-you-COVID=_2, scam=_4, DNA=_5 with rows 4/5 on _1/_3 in either order; next best is 2.547. SOURCE DISCREPANCY: Table 1 prints 12% for the DNA row but COVVAXINFO_5's 12.567 rounds to 13, so no assignment reproduces all five printed percentages; DNA=_5 is the best fit (alternatives put 12.567 on an 11% row, deviation 1.57), not an exact match. COVVAXINFO_1 and COVVAXINFO_3 are 'The COVID-19 vaccine causes infertility.' and 'People receiving the COVID-19 vaccine will "shed" dangerous chemicals from that vaccine.' in unknown order: both print as 11% (live 11.198 vs 11.392), so their item_text is shipped BLANK rather than guessed. Published 5-item scale alpha .93/M 2.16/SD 1.06 reproduced (0.9306/2.1596/1.0591), confirming scale identity and direction only. No instructions/stem published for this block, so instructions blank. Options: only the Table 1 footnote names responses ('agree' and 'strongly agree'), placed on resp 4 and 5 (the >=4 cut is the do-file's dichotomisation and reproduces the percentages); 5 = strongly agree by ascending convention; resp 1-3 blank. Rights: study-authored items (Uscinski/Enders team) printed in a CC BY article; no instrument_rights_register.csv row applies and no restriction found to quote, so extracted normally; no register row written.
